# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It includes variable and color fonts, animated WebP encoding, configurable surface sampling, and a reworked singleton lifecycle. Pixel access, typeface initialization, SKPath finalization, Android GL views, and WinUI loading are more reliable. This is a breaking release; review the migration notes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy SKPaint APIs and other pre-v4 obsoletes are now errors** — Legacy `SKPaint` text and font state members are now compile errors, and remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are trimmed from reference assemblies. Move typeface, text size, hinting, and text encoding to `SKFont`, use the `SKCanvas.DrawText` overloads that accept it, and replace other obsolete APIs before upgrading. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed** — The Skia m147 update removes the EOL Tizen arm and x86 native builds. Move Tizen deployments to the `tizen-arm64` or `tizen-x64` assets. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **WASM native assets require .NET 8 or later** — Native assets for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are removed. Retarget Blazor WASM and Uno Platform WASM projects on .NET 6 or .NET 7 to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **new SKFont() uses an empty typeface** — A parameterless `SKFont` now contains `SKTypeface.Empty`, so text measures as zero and draws nothing until a typeface is assigned. Construct it with `SKTypeface.Default` or another explicit typeface, and use `Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of a null check. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKPaint and SKTypeface fallback semantics changed** — `new SKPaint().Typeface` now returns `SKTypeface.Default`, and `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` returns the default rather than null for a missing family on Android. Replace paint null checks with the appropriate `IsEmpty` logic; use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily` when a strict no-match null result is required. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) rejects offsets outside the 32-bit range** — The obsolete `SKStream.Move(long)` overload now throws `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating an out-of-range offset. Validate the value and call `Move(int)`. ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Vulkan Ganesh requires Vulkan 1.1** — `GRContext.CreateVulkan` now terminates the process for a Vulkan 1.0 context instead of returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` to the same supported version; choose another backend up front on Vulkan 1.0-only hardware.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative removes legacy fields** — The native Vulkan context removes `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Delete those assignments, use `fVkExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures` or `fDeviceFeatures2`, and manage instance and device ownership outside the context.
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion types and layout changed** — `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` becomes `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`, loses its value-equality members, and gains a `Components` field through the new `GRVkYcbcrComponents` layout. Update type references, equality code, manual construction, and native-layout assumptions. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only** — The protected setter is removed from `IgnorePublicDispose`. Derived wrappers can no longer change it after construction and should select the appropriate disposal behavior in their constructor path. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Assembly version advances to 4.x** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and hard-coded assembly-version checks. ([#3640](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3640), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m119 to m148** — The bundled engine spans the m132, m133, and m147 upgrades through m148, bringing codec orientation, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, CICP color spaces, newer filters, and accumulated rendering fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp can query variation axes, clone typefaces at design coordinates, select built-in palettes, and override individual palette colors. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Bundled native libraries refreshed** — Updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz to newer upstream releases. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## API Surface

- **Animated WebP encoding** — `SKWebpEncoder` adds single-frame and animated encoding overloads, with frame durations represented by `SKWebpEncoderFrame`. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Sampling control for surface draws** — `SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface` gain `SKSamplingOptions` overloads for choosing filtering and mipmap behavior. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Zero-copy access to memory-backed stream data** — `SKStream.GetData()` returns the backing `SKData` when the native stream can expose it cheaply. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **New document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs** — Adds `SKDocument.CreateXps`, per-resource `GRContext.Flush`, `SKMaskFilter.CreateShader`, `SKColorSpace.CreateCicp`, HDR color types, and the correctly ordered `HBColor` value type. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel spans honor row bytes and coordinates** — `SKPixmap` and `SKBitmap` pixel spans now use `RowBytes` for stride, while `GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y)` computes its offset with the correct axis. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Typeface defaults initialize reliably** — Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font-manager path, avoiding Android API 36 startup crashes and returning an empty typeface as a safe last resort. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **SKPath finalization no longer races its builder** — Disposal no longer flushes a collected `SKPathBuilder`, preventing a finalizer-thread native crash. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Platform view and projection loading fixed** — Android `SKGLView` retains its dimensions across navigation and tab switches, and .NET 9 WinUI consumers can load the Projection assembly from the package. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Font and stream edge cases corrected** — Undersized variable-font spans report correct write counts, glyph checks avoid infinite recursion, and negative stream moves preserve the correct native value. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Process-wide wrappers now use a managed lifecycle with coordinated ownership, disposal, and finalization across singleton object graphs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native compatibility check runs on first API use** — The compatibility gate moves from a module initializer to the `SkiaApi` type constructor, avoiding module-load failures for applications that never use SkiaSharp. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic assets for x64 and arm64** — Dedicated `linux-bionic` runtime assets support Android-hosted Linux environments for both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen gains 64-bit native assets** — Adds official `tizen-x64` and `tizen-arm64` package assets while the Skia m147 transition retires 32-bit Tizen builds. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Apple libraries target the base 26.0 SDK** — Versioned library TFMs use 26.0 for broader Xcode 26 compatibility, while apps use unversioned Apple TFMs. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WASM targets .NET 8 and later** — The WebAssembly package removes native assets for older Emscripten versions and now supports the .NET 8-or-later toolchain. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0
